ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

defs.def: present in a place; available 出现；现有；可用

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: All around the world, there are small changes taking place.
ex.t: 全世界各地都在发生着微小的变化。

ex.s: Place a few mirrors around your room so people can see how things look when they try them on.
ex.t: 在房间里放几面镜子，这样人们试穿时能看到效果。

ex.s: A GI could, its advocates say, work for us around the clock, and drawing on all available data, could suggest solutions to many problems.
ex.t: 其支持者说，AGI可以日夜不停地为我们工作，并借助一切可用数据，为许多问题提出解决方案。

defs.def: active and well known in a sport, profession, etc. （体育运动、专业等中）走红的，活跃的

ex.s: The bay was   45   in sunshine, and there was a group of kayakers around 150m off the shore.
ex.t: 海湾___45___在阳光中，离岸约150米处有一群皮划艇运动员。

ex.s: I guess that there's probably some demanding work schedule, or social anxiety around stepping up to help for an unknown sport.
ex.t: 我猜大概是有些苛刻的工作安排，或是对于为一个不熟悉的运动挺身相助的社会焦虑。

ex.s: Things are going well, but there is always something new just around the corner.
ex.t: 一切进展顺利，但拐角处总会有新鲜事物。

ex.s: However, that was small fry compared with the city’s Circus Maximus, which accommodated around 250,000 people.
ex.t: 然而，与这座城市可容纳约250,000人的 Circus Maximus相比，那就小巫见大巫了。

ex.s: Some people seem willing to work around the clock in their narrow specialty.
ex.t: 有些人似乎愿意在自己狭窄的专业领域夜以继日地工作。

defs.def: in a circle or curve to face another way or the opposite way 转弯；掉转；掉头

ex.s: Gunter parked the taxi behind the bus, turned around, and looked at me with a big smile on his face.
ex.t: Gunter把出租车停在巴士后面，转过身，脸上挂着大大的笑容看着我。

ex.s: Gunter parked the taxi behind the bus, turned around, and looked at me with a big smile on his face.
ex.t: Gunter把出租车停在巴士后面，转过身，脸上挂着大大的笑容看着我。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: Though Smith did get her hands on the best sand, doing things the old-fashioned way isn't just about playing around with French mud.
ex.t: 虽然史密斯确实得到了她的手 最好的沙子，做一些事情 旧式的方式 不只是玩弄法国泥。

ex.s: But they must realize that the employment market is about how an employee will be a good fit for a company, not the other way around.
ex.t: 但他们必须意识到，就业市场关乎员工如何契合公司，而非相反。

defs.def: surrounding sb/sth; on each side of sth 围绕；环绕

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

defs.def: on, to or from the other side of sb/sth 在那边；到那边；从那边

ex.s: That's why most pet cats are able to tell immediately if their owners were around any other cats, which they don't usually like.
ex.t: 这就是为什么大多数宠物猫能立刻察觉主人是否接触过其他猫——而它们通常不喜欢这样。

ex.s: Long curtains had been pulled around my bed,  16  me from the other patients.
ex.t: 长窗帘已经被拉到我的床边，16 把我和其他病人隔开。

ex.s: Not only can you post specific questions, but you can broaden your knowledge by reading posts from other English learners around the world.
ex.t: 你不仅可以发布具体问题，还可以通过阅读来自世界各地其他英语学习者的帖子来扩展你的知识。

ex.s: In her first PE class , Eva was shocked when Coach Pitt announced that everyone had to run one mile around the track outside.
ex.t: 在第一节体育课上，伊娃震惊地发现皮特教练宣布每个人都必须绕着外面的跑道跑一英里。

defs.def: in or to many places in an area 到处；向各处
to fit in with particular people, ideas, etc. 同 … 一致；适合；符合

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。
